In [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]], a '''skirmish''' too place in the [[Purnham system/Legends|Purnham system]] between a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] acting out from a asteroid group in the [[Purnham system/Legends|Purnham system]] and the crews of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and ''[[Melnor Spear]]'' who had formed an uneasy alliance of convenience. During the battle one of the pirate ships was destroyed and only two members of the crew of the other pirate vessel survived to be interrogated by the members of the [[Hand of Judgment]].
